questions.question: 1. Augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR) are the same?

explanations.b: AR and VR are different — VR immerses users in a completely virtual world, while AR adds digital elements to the real world.

questions.question: 2.How will we interact with technology in the future?

explanations.d: Future technologies aim to use brain–computer interfaces, allowing people to control devices with their thoughts instead of physical input.

questions.question: 3. How can Virtual Reality help architects in designing a house?

explanations.b: VR enables architects and clients to virtually explore the house design in 3D, making it easier to visualize spaces before actual construction.

questions.question: 4. What is one major benefit of using VR in architecture?

answers.b: Helps in visualizing real-world scale and lighting
answers.c: Eliminates the need for any software

explanations.b: VR helps architects understand spatial relationships, lighting, and scale as they would appear in the real world.

questions.question: 5. Which tool is often used for creating VR architectural models?

explanations.c: Game engines like Unreal Engine or Unity are commonly used to create immersive, interactive VR experiences for architectural visualization.
